Good. Now I have everything I need. Let me create the three new files.

The key observations:
1. `app.ts:183` mounts `healthRoutes(db, opts)` at `/health` under the `api` router (which is at `/api`), so the existing handler `router.get("/")` matches `/api/health`. The existing signature is `healthRoutes(db?, opts?)` returning a Router — this must be preserved exactly.
2. `express.d.ts` shows the full actor shape on `req.actor` — type is `"board" | "agent" | "none"`.
3. `ActorContext` in `types.ts` only needs the transport-agnostic subset (`"board" | "agent"`, no `"none"` since `null` covers unauthenticated).
